alignment_review.alignment_basis: time-coded automatic transcription of the v4 master
alignment_review.machine_transcription_word_review: Keep detected wording unchanged until human audition confirms ambiguous phonemes.
alignment_review.gate: Lyric-locked scene development is released against the v4 transcription; final vocal copy remains subject to human audition for phonetic corrections.

scenes.lyric: I hear the lock click. / I hear the clock tick. / Pressure made a language in, and I talk it. / No mask, no myth, no borrowed flame. / I walk in with the wound…
scenes.action: KTD turns a real lock, then sings directly into a practical handheld microphone while touching the wound under his shirt. His mouth must articulate every supplied phoneme; breath, jaw, throat, eyes and hand gesture respond to the lyric before he begins the frontal walk through the wet industrial corridor. The dolly-back carries the sung action into S02.

scenes.lyric: I walk in with the wound and I leave with a name. / I was built in the break where the brave get tested. / Every breath in the stress got sharp, got weapon. / I write like lightning, strike through silence. / Turned out the dust…
scenes.action: A continuous walk through the corridor becomes a hand dragged across wet concrete; KTD leaves a charcoal mark while dust, rain and fabric move. The mark becomes the physical entry to S03.

scenes.lyric: Turned out the dust with a disciplined violence. / Not blood, just bars that bruise the lie. / A hard truth rising when the soft words die. / I bring quick wit…
scenes.action: The charcoal line becomes bars of light across a metal gate. KTD switches a latch and pushes the gate open; the camera pans with the hand and crosses into the technical room.

scenes.lyric: I bring quick wit, split-second switch. / Trip the rhythm, flip the script, never miss. / Kairos on the pulse, I am locked in the grid. / Every scar is a charge, every bar is a bid. / Slow down…
scenes.action: KTD performs while changing a real patch cable in a grid of LEDs. The camera orbits a fraction around his torso and slows visibly with the words “Slow down”, leaving the room breathing.

scenes.lyric: Slow down, let the room feel the weight. / One breath, then I open the gate.
scenes.action: KTD holds one visible breath in a narrow wet chamber, then pushes open a heavy industrial gate. Vapor gathers and releases with the door; the camera pushes through behind him.

scenes.lyric: I move too fast for the fear to frame me. / Move too fast for the fear to frame me. / Talk too sharp for the doubt to tame me. / Pressure made me. / They say I am finished.
scenes.action: KTD crosses several doorframes in one fluid tracking move. Light bands try to frame him but slide off his body; he closes the last door on “finished” without losing eye contact.

scenes.lyric: The sound just changed me. / Now I cut through the clutter with a mutter then a thunder. / Double-time runner, no wonder they wonder. / I stack that syntax…
scenes.action: The closed door opens into the same corridor under a new practical lighting state. KTD accelerates his hand performance and pulls a real cable behind him; the camera tracks backward faster.

scenes.lyric: I stack that syntax, snap back, backtrack. / Packs in the fast forward, no slack in the black track. / Now…
scenes.action: KTD enters the recording booth, clips the cable to a patchbay, backtracks one step and grips the microphone. LEDs and smoke remain physically active; the isolated “Now” slows the camera.

scenes.lyric: Now. / I not chase crowns, I chase clear vision.
scenes.action: The sustained “Now” holds KTD in a moving pool of rain and vapor, not a frozen pose. He then resumes a frontal walk through shallow floodwater; the amber reflection is a practical street light, not a crown.

scenes.lyric: Turn every closed door’s ice, clear vision. / Turn every closed door to a forced decision. / If the night wants proof, let the night take notes. / I carry hard hope…
scenes.action: KTD finds a blue-lit sealed door, writes on its condensation and pushes it open. The camera crosses the threshold with him; the practical amber source enters the background as proof and hope.

scenes.lyric: I carry hard hope in the back of my throat. / Halftime hear me, double-time fear me. / Halftime hear me, double-time fear me. / Not for harm, but the truth gets near me.
scenes.action: KTD performs in a broad wet room, moving at halftime while the camera makes a controlled arc. Vapor responds to breath and a side light models throat, face and tattoos.

scenes.lyric: Not for harm, but the truth gets near me. / I bring the cold rain, the gold pain, the old flame. / Then I name every chain till it forgets my name. / Pain was a prison…
scenes.action: Rain enters the room. KTD pulls a real chain from a metal door and releases it; the metal vibrates, the water falls and the gold flame exists only as a moving reflection.

scenes.lyric: Pain was a prison, I taught it a rhythm. / Silence was heavy, I learned how to lift it. / No pause, no pose, no borrowed code.
scenes.action: KTD converts the chain drag into deliberate footwork and hand taps on concrete. He lifts a light metal barrier and walks through it; the camera rises with the physical lift.

scenes.lyric: Banks load in the mode that I chose on the road. / Fast breath, fresh steps, raw text, no rest. / Kairos in the water, I am more than the test.
scenes.action: KTD walks through a live flooded street beside an industrial wall, breathing quickly but controlled. The camera holds the official chest-height dolly-back and finishes as the vocal line ends.

scenes.action: The march continues into an open rain-soaked space. KTD crosses cold and amber practical light while the camera moves from frontal to three-quarter view without resetting the action.

scenes.action: KTD returns to the rain-covered window from the opening. He places his hand on the glass and breathes; water runs outward while condensation remains in motion.

scenes.action: Close live-action finish: KTD returns his gaze to the lens, lowers his hand, turns and exits frame. Rain, vapor and reflections continue through a hard cut to black at 168 seconds.
